Dynamic Bridge Resumed Normal Operations - Chaleur - Miscou - south - Shippegan
Shippegan Bridge is open Monday to Friday from 0900UTC to 0100UTC. On Saturdays, Sundays, and outside of regular hours, bridge opening will be available on call only, by contacting one of the following two bridge attendants: Bertrand Chiasson, telephone 506-337-5204 or Robert Landry, telephone 506-888-9999.
